# Bundled third-party libraries

Unmodified browser builds, taken from the npm registry with `npm pack` at the pinned versions below. Each library's license is in `licenses/`.

| Library | Version | Files | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| [markdown-it](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it) | 14.1.0 | `markdown-it.min.js` | MIT |
| [markdown-it-footnote](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it-footnote) | 4.0.0 | `markdown-it-footnote.min.js` | MIT |
| [highlight.js](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js) (`@highlightjs/cdn-assets`) | 11.10.0 | `highlight.min.js`, `hljs-github.min.css`, `hljs-github-dark.min.css` | BSD-3-Clause |
| [KaTeX](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX) | 0.16.11 | `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `fonts/*.woff2` | MIT |
| [Mermaid](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid) | 11.4.1 | `mermaid.min.js` | MIT |
| [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.2.3 | `purify.min.js` | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |

The Commons Clause in this repository's `LICENSE` applies to Markdown Reader's own code. These libraries remain under their own licenses.
